 One improvement I would like to see in the college is the enhancement of practical learning
opportunities. While theoretical knowledge is important, more hands-on experience through
workshops, internships, field visits, and updated lab equipment would help us understand our
subjects better and prepare for real-world challenges. Additionally, I believe improving the
college infrastructure—such as smart classrooms, Wi-Fi access, and library resources—would
create a better learning environment. Encouraging student activities like seminars, career
counseling, and skill development programs would also contribute to our overall growth.

I would like to see several improvements in the college to enhance both academics and
student life. Firstly, better infrastructure like modern classrooms, well-equipped laboratories,
and a more extensive library would greatly benefit students. Secondly, regular workshops,
guest lectures, and skill-development programs could help students prepare better for future
careers. Improving sports and cultural facilities would also encourage overall development.
Lastly, I feel there should be more focus on digital resources and student feedback systems to
ensure continuous improvement in teaching and administration.
